locations: causal field of Maya and the three gunas
continuity.notes: Use the D005 intake images only as subject/composition references; do not copy their glossy rendering, collages, diagrams, or visible words. Use the approved Guruvayurappan sheet for identity and the selected D001 matte candidates only for rendering style. Depict Vishnu with four clearly separated arms and standard attributes when the scene calls for the iconic cosmic form; ordinary humans, including Bhattathiri, have exactly two arms. The thousand heads/hands/feet in S010 are an intentional Virat-form exception and must be arranged in ordered, clearly attached tiers. Keep cosmological stages distinct without written labels. Landscape first; portraits remain paused.

must_show: A single serene divine presence in the immeasurable stillness after cosmic dissolution
Maya latent within the Lord, with sattva, rajas, and tamas in perfectly balanced, motionless mineral-color bands
No manifested worlds, day, night, death, or liberation; the Lord alone is the focal source of bliss-consciousness
scene_brief.composition: A wide, quiet cosmic field with the Lord at center-left and broad empty dark-indigo space around him; use still water and a faint balanced three-color ring, no serpent-bed or secondary deity.
avoid: stars used as a literal clock
sun or moon implying day and night

stanzas.alt: The Lord alone in the stillness after cosmic dissolution

must_show: Time, karma, the three gunas, living beings, and the universe resting in causal form within the Lord’s pure consciousness
A calm, all-pervading divine presence without implying these causes were absolutely nonexistent
A subtle visual contrast between unmanifest causal seeds and a universe not yet formed
scene_brief.composition: One luminous blue four-armed Vishnu form anchors a quiet dark cosmic ocean; delicate concentric mineral bands and seed-like lights are held within the aura, with no separate crowd of souls.

stanzas.alt: The causal universe resting within the Lord

scene_brief.mode: divine glance activates Maya and creation
must_show: The Lord’s gentle creative glance after an immeasurable cycle
Maya awakening from latency
Time, karmic impressions, and resulting tendencies emerging as three distinct symbolic currents that begin to unfold the worlds
scene_brief.composition: A single clear glance from the four-armed Lord activates a veiled field; three clean streams flow outward into a nascent universe, with the Lord and Maya clearly separate.

stanzas.alt: The divine glance that awakens creation

scene_brief.mode: witness beyond Maya and emergence of Mahat
must_show: The Lord as an unaffected witness beside a translucent Maya veil
Living beings suggested as simple reflections, not duplicate copies of the Lord
Maya, stirred by time and the Lord’s prompting, opening a first clear lotus-like principle of intelligence called Mahat
scene_brief.composition: Keep one complete four-armed Lord outside a shallow reflective veil; reflections remain faint and small, while one luminous Mahat lotus emerges at the edge of the veil.

stanzas.alt: The witness beyond Maya and the birth of Mahat

scene_brief.mode: Mahat, cosmic I, and individual ego
must_show: Mahat shown as composed of all three gunas yet predominantly sattvic
One unified cosmic field suggesting the undivided collective I
Rajas and tamas introducing distinct individual ego-seeds by the Lord’s will
scene_brief.composition: A broad luminous sattva field occupies the center; two darker, clearly separated bands release a few small individual light-seeds at the margin. The Lord remains a calm witness, not duplicated.
avoid: a crowd of nearly identical people

stanzas.alt: Mahat and the arising of individual identity

scene_brief.mode: three guna forms of ahamkara and presiding deities
must_show: Ahamkara branching into sattva, rajas, and tamas as separate mineral-color streams
Presiding powers for the senses, organs of action, and inner faculties represented through distinct simple emblems
The Lord’s will as the source of this ordered emergence
scene_brief.composition: A clear three-part mural structure around one central lotus: sensory emblems, action emblems, and inner-faculty emblems occupy separate open bands. Suggest the presiding deities through small contained aura motifs rather than a crowded assembly of bodies.

stanzas.alt: Presiding powers emerge from the three gunas

scene_brief.mode: creation of inner faculties, senses, and sound
must_show: The sattvic stream bringing forth mind, intellect, ego, and memory as four distinct nonverbal symbols
The rajasic stream giving rise to the ten sense and action faculties, suggested by paired simple emblems
Sound arising from the tamasic stream as the subtle essence of space
scene_brief.composition: Three separated flowing bands cross a wide field: four quiet inner-faculty symbols in the first, five paired sense/action motifs in the second, and one sound ripple opening into space in the third. No people are needed.
avoid: icons that look like modern infographic UI

stanzas.alt: The inner faculties and senses arise from ahamkara

scene_brief.mode: progression of subtle and gross elements
must_show: A readable progression from sound to space, touch to air, form to fire, taste to water, and smell to earth
Each later element inheriting the qualities of those before it
The Lord as the source of the entire ordered sequence
scene_brief.composition: A continuous left-to-right landscape sequence of five connected mineral-color zones: open space with sound ripples, flowing air, flame and form, water, then earth with scent-bearing flowers. The Lord’s calm gesture initiates the sequence.

stanzas.alt: The sequence from sound to the elements

scene_brief.mode: divine activation and formation of Hiranyagarbha
must_show: The elements, senses, organs of action, and their presiding powers shown as separate systems unable to form the universe alone
The presiding powers praising the Lord through simple, wordless gesture
The Lord entering, activating, and combining the principles into one golden cosmic egg
scene_brief.composition: Distinct elemental and sense-symbol clusters converge toward a single central golden egg as a four-armed Vishnu presence enters the scene. Keep symbols separated and the egg clearly whole.

stanzas.alt: The principles combine into the golden cosmic egg

must_show: The cosmic egg resting in the waters and then opening into the Virat form with fourteen world-bands
A colossal integrated cosmic form representing all living beings, with many heads, hands, and feet arranged in deliberate, readable, symmetrical tiers as explicitly described in the stanza
Bhattathiri at the foreground in a dignified two-armed prayer, asking Guruvayurappan for relief from his afflictions
scene_brief.composition: A wide mural with the opened cosmic egg and Virat occupying most of the frame; fourteen clear horizontal world-bands form the body. Use orderly repeated head and limb motifs attached to the cosmic silhouette, not a tangled pile of arms. Place one small, anatomically clear Bhattathiri in prayer at the lower edge.

stanzas.alt: The Virat form and Bhattathiri’s prayer
